confidence_notes: Beer, coffee, cocktail, wine and restaurant anchors are medium confidence. They rest on 2026-dated Hobart travel and nightlife guides (Cities Insider menu data from March 2026, a 2026 travel-budget guide), plus undated Expat Exchange and Daily Tasmania figures. No official restaurant price survey was found, and the beer anchor is an estimated restaurant serving. Accommodation anchors (dorm, private hostel, 1-star and 3-star hotel) are low confidence holistic model estimates. I did not search for or inspect any accommodation listings, and July is Tasmanian winter, so off-season rates are assumed. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could verify (2026-03-20). It is older than the 2026-10-16 generation date, and I did not find a newer RBA value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Oceania, based on Australian capital-city and Tasmanian price levels. Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Hobart price evidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a small Australian capital in winter, without a comparable-city search.
